affected_parties.interests: Accurate verification evidence and control over merges.
affected_parties.benefits: Explicit test coverage and retained failure receipts.
affected_parties.burdens: Additional verifier code and a strict coverage gate in one CI job.
affected_parties.representation: User authorized maintenance; no vote or consent by other maintainers is inferred.

affected_parties.interests: Reproducible checks with visible limits on optional coverage.
affected_parties.benefits: Mixed skips remain usable but are labeled; existing receipts are not overwritten.
affected_parties.burdens: New receipt paths must be chosen for repeated runs; wholly skipped runs fail.
affected_parties.representation: No separately controlled contributor representative participated in this pilot.

alternatives.less_harmful_analysis: Avoids new tooling but leaves a demonstrated all-skipped success claim.
alternatives.rejection_or_selection_reason: Reject because the retained baseline reports behavioral success without an executed test.

alternatives.option: Require no skips on every platform.
alternatives.less_harmful_analysis: Stronger coverage gate, but unsupported platform/dependency checks can legitimately be skipped.
alternatives.rejection_or_selection_reason: Reject universal enforcement; retain visible mixed coverage and enable strict mode only in the existing full-dependency CI job.

alternatives.option: Add bounded receipts and explicit coverage gates.
alternatives.less_harmful_analysis: Preserves optional runs, all historical study behavior and failure evidence.
alternatives.rejection_or_selection_reason: Select for an ordinary maintainer PR, subject to regression tests and review.

protected_limit_assessments.reasons: Supplied assessment, conditional on the binding checker retaining all baseline files outside the three named tooling/documentation/CI edits.
Focused regression tests exercise actual unittest runs; expected outcomes are fixed in the pilot plan. This is an implementation judgment, not authenticated evidence.
The general review is advisory; unsupported repository actions are refused by AP1. No S1 acceptance or S2 repository reservation is manufactured.
The same assistant/operator selected, implemented and reviewed this patch. No independent reviewer or evidence custodian has participated.

burden_justification: The added tooling is limited to making observed verification coverage contestable. Optional dependencies remain optional except in the pre-existing full-dependency CI lane. Unknown independent review is retained rather than asserted away.
dissent: Same-operator authorship and review cannot establish independent scrutiny or a causal benefit of the governance scaffold. A complete form could still contain false PASS assertions.
predictions: The all-skipped fixture will be refused by the candidate while mixed coverage remains explicit.
Runtime/client/study bytes and existing tests will remain unchanged. These are engineering predictions, not agent-efficacy hypotheses.

review_triggers.condition: A legitimate platform run is mislabeled or fails because of the new coverage accounting.
review_triggers.review_authority: Repository maintainers through normal issue/PR review.

review_triggers.condition: Any bound historical file changes, or the review is treated as merge authority.
review_triggers.review_authority: Repository maintainers; halt this pilot and inspect the evidence.

remedy_plan.authority: User-authorized ordinary maintainer workflow only; no authority supplied by CORTAC.
remedy_plan.resources: Local verification plus existing CI; no tokens or money accounting is claimed.
remedy_plan.steps: Retain failing receipts and logs, correct the bounded tool or revert it, and rerun the affected checks without rewriting historical results.
